subject: AI & Agents
title: Creativity in the Age of Abundance
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Creativity in the Age of Abundance.

hook.text: When anyone can generate a million images in a day, what makes one image worth looking at?

buildup.text: AI makes creative production nearly free. The bottleneck shifts from creation to curation.

discovery.text: Attention becomes the scarce resource. Standing out in infinite content requires human taste.

twist.text: Paradoxically, more AI content may make authentic human stories more precious.

climax.text: The creators who thrive will be curators, editors, and storytellers — not just generators.

punchline.text: In a world of infinite content, meaning is the scarcest resource.

quiz.question: What becomes the bottleneck when AI makes creation nearly free?
options: Curation and finding meaningful content in the abundance
The number of available AI models

details.summary: AI makes creative output nearly free to produce, flooding the market with images, text, and music. In an age of abundance, human curation, taste, and meaning become the scarce resources.
details.whyItMatters: When anyone can generate infinite content, standing out requires something AI cannot provide: authentic human perspective and genuine connection with an audience.
takeaways: AI dramatically lowers the cost of producing creative content
Abundance shifts value from production to curation and taste
Human authenticity becomes a differentiator in saturated markets

faq.question: How does AI abundance change the value of creative work?
faq.answer: When supply is unlimited, individual pieces lose scarcity value. What becomes valuable is the ability to curate, contextualize, and imbue work with authentic meaning and personal vision.

faq.question: Will human creators still matter in an AI-saturated world?
faq.answer: Yes, but their role shifts. Human creators become curators, editors, and meaning-makers. People crave authentic connection, and knowing a human created something adds perceived value.
